pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark brown patches exhibit irregular, stellate geometries with highly serrated, non-linear edge gradients. Patches on the upper neck are elongated and vertically oriented, while those on the shoulder transition to broader, multi-pointed polygonal shapes with sharp pixel-level transitions at the boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of cream-colored negative space forms a topological graph of intersecting pathways. The pathways maintain a relatively uniform thickness across the visible neck and shoulder regions. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate intersections where three corridors converge at distinct vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane on the upper neck presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. The 1D geometric contour consists of densely packed vertical filaments creating a textured, jagged edge against the out-of-focus background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: The visible segment of the mane line is structurally continuous with no identifiable breaks, gaps, or abrupt discontinuities in the silhouette.
